summary: Reads a job description and pulls out the company, role, location, sector, seniority, remote status, and application link.
why: Likely reason: saves the user typing the same details by hand.
how: Checks the text is present, builds a prompt with the first 6000 characters and the exact JSON format, asks the AI, and returns the fields.
inputs: Job description text and optional provider settings.
outputs: The parsed fields, or an error with status 400 or 500.
risks: Only the first 6000 characters are read, so later details are missed. The AI output is not checked, so a sector may fall outside the list.
debug: Empty fields mean the AI could not find them. Check the text length and the AI reply.
